Wat is de ziekte van Sever? Symptomen en: What is Sever's disease? Symptoms and advice — ZOL Solutions
De naam klinkt zwaar, maar Sever is een: The name may sound serious, but Sever's is a common, growth-related cause of heel pain in active children.
Bij de ziekte van Sever raakt de groeizo: In Sever's disease, the growth area at the back of the heel becomes irritated. Symptoms occur mainly during periods of growth and are often noticeable in sports involving a lot of running, jumping and pushing off.
De medische naam is calcaneale apofysiti: The medical term is calcaneal apophysitis. A growing child still has a growth area at the back of the heel bone. The Achilles tendon and calf muscles pull on this area. Repeated impact and rapid growth can make it sensitive. Despite its name, Sever's is not an infectious or permanent disease.
De gevoelige plek zit meestal rond de gr: The sensitive area is usually around the growth plate at the back of the heel bone.

De pijn zit meestal achter of onder de h: Pain is usually at the back of or under the heel and increases during or after physical activity. The heel may feel tender when gently squeezed at the sides. Some children limp, walk on their toes or want to stop training early. One or both heels may be affected.

Groei en herhaalde belasting spelen same: Growth and repeated loading both play a role. During a growth spurt, bones may temporarily grow faster than muscles and tendons can adapt. Sports involving short sprints, jumps, stops and changes of direction put extra load on the heel. A sudden increase in training hours, hard surfaces or poorly cushioned shoes may also make symptoms more noticeable. This does not mean that a single training session or type of shoe is the cause.

Pain clearly located around the heel and linked to sporting activity is more suggestive of a local heel problem. Only a healthcare professional can assess what is happening in an individual child.
